\*Data above 298 K estimated. Phase changes: 942 K, α - β transition point of U; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 0.667$ kcal/mol. 1049 K, $\beta - \gamma$ transition point of U; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 1.137$ kcal/mol. 1408 K, melting point of U; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 2.185$ kcal/mol. Heat capacity (cal/mol·K) and enthalpy (kcal/mol) equations: 298.15-2000 K: $Cp^{\circ} = 15.494 + 1.736 \times 10^{-3} T - 0.028 \times 10^{5} T^{-2}$ $H^{\circ}-H_{298}^{\circ}=15.494\times10^{-3}T+0.868\times10^{-6}T^{2}+0.028\times10^{2}T^{-1}-4.706$ Reaction equations (kcal/mol):
298.15-942 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -129.671 + 6.127 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 3.594 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 39.075 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -129.671 - 6.127 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T + 3.594 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 19.538 \text{T}^{-1} + 68.191 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
942-1049 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -127.261 - 1.018 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 0.628 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 48.425 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -127.261 + 1.018 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T - 0.628 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 24.212 \text{T}^{-1} + 20.730 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1049-1408 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -129.557 + 0.087 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 0.628 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 48.425 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -129.557 - 0.087 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T - 0.628 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 24.212 \text{T}^{-1} + 30.605 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1408-2000 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -128.250 - 2.393 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 0.628 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 48.425 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -128.250 + 2.393 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T - 0.628 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 24.212 \text{T}^{-1} + 11.697 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
Source: Data from Gronvold (47) who estimated all above 298 K.
